I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm their Tamsin Cold Chain pickups now use Dock 15. I said I'll keep it between us. The first send failed because I used the wrong tool, so I posted the reply straight into the DM instead.

I didn't save the note anywhere else. GBrain's notes are in a source other people can read, and my own memory carries into other members' conversations, so saving it in either place could leak it. The note lives only in our DM.

GBrain had nothing on Dana's dock. It only had general North team and Tamsin Cold Chain notes that don't bear on this.
